moves.e4: Claims the center and opens lines for the queen and the light-squared bishop.

moves.c6: The Caro-Kann: prepares ...d5 to challenge e4 while keeping the c8-bishop's diagonal open.

moves.d4: Builds a full pawn center on e4 and d4.

moves.d5: Strikes at e4; the c6-pawn supports d5.

moves.Nc3: Defends e4 with a piece while developing.

moves.dxe4: Releases the tension by taking the e4-pawn; White will recapture with the knight.

moves.Nf6: Challenges the centralized knight straight away.

moves.Ng5: The Alien Gambit: avoids the knight trade and eyes f7, hoping for ...h6 so that Nxf7 becomes possible.
moves.Nxf6+: The main line: trades knights and forces Black to recapture with a pawn.

rnbqkb1r/pp2pppp/2p2n2/8/3PN3/8/PPP2PPP/.plan: Decide between the solid main line (Nxf6+) and the Alien Gambit (Ng5).

moves.h6: Questions the knight; this is the reply the gambit is hoping for.

moves.Nxf7: The sacrifice: the knight takes the f7-pawn to drag Black's king into the open. White is giving up a knight for a pawn; engines judge it unsound.

moves.Kxf7: Takes the knight; Black is up a piece for a pawn but the king has lost its shelter.

rnbq1b1r/pp2pkp1/2p2n1p/8/3P4/8/PPP2PPP/.plan: White: develop fast and keep the king in the open — Bc4+ is a typical follow-up. Black: tuck the king away and return material if needed to finish development.
